summary: Completed initial MVP testing of BRUH Assistant. Frontend UI working well with Neo-Brutalist design. Critical backend authentication error handling issues found. Brain of BRUH modules (Calculator, Timer) fully functional. Authentication flow partially working but inconsistent.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns 500 errors with '401: Invalid session' message instead of proper 401 HTTP status codes
critical_bugs.impact: Prevents proper error handling in frontend and breaks API contract

critical_bugs.issue: MongoDB ObjectId serialization error causing 500 errors

design_issues.issue: HTTPExceptions are being caught and re-raised as 500 errors instead of preserving original status codes

authentication_issues.issue: Brain page accessible without authentication while Dashboard requires it

design_issues.issue: Box shadows not fully implementing hard drop shadow style from design guidelines

passed_tests: Login page loads with correct design and elements
All 4 feature cards (Student, Crop, Cook, Brain) display correctly
Google login button present and clickable
Typography using correct fonts (Outfit for headings)
Authentication redirect from dashboard to login works
Brain of BRUH page loads with all 5 modules
Calculator module fully functional (calculations, clear, navigation)
Timer module fully functional (start/pause, reset, display)
Neo-Brutalist design elements (colors, borders, layout) implemented
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical backend authentication error handling - all protected endpoints should return proper 401 HTTP status codes instead of 500 errors. Fix route protection inconsistency between Brain and Dashboard pages. These issues prevent testing of core chat functionality, file uploads, and CRUD operations for Notes/Tasks/Calendar.

success_percentage.backend: 30% - Server running, basic connectivity works, but authentication error handling broken
success_percentage.frontend: 85% - UI/UX excellent, design implemented well, but authentication flow inconsistent
